decisions.notebook: Preferred initial composition is Altaria/Mamoswine lead with Armarouge and Sneasler in back; preserve Sneasler as the fast response to Mega Alakazam or Scrafty, and use Mamoswine to pressure Garchomp and Talonflame.

reflections.summary: Won by denying Altaria’s support with turn-one Taunt and using Mega Alakazam Protect plus Talonflame pressure to safely remove Mamoswine and Sneasler. The critical Shadow Ball KO on Armarouge accelerated the cleanout. Team preview was well suited: Alakazam/Talonflame/Garchomp/Floette was an appropriate four, and Mega Alakazam was the right Mega into their revealed fast offensive-support composition.
reflections.adjustment: In game 2, if Farigiraf is brought, prioritize Mega Alakazam pressure into it (for example Shadow Ball) rather than relying on Talonflame’s priority Brave Bird, which Armor Tail can block; respect Mental Herb making a first Taunt unreliable.
reflections.notebook: G1 reveal: opponent led Altaria + Focus Sash Adamant Mamoswine and brought Life Orb Modest Armarouge plus Jolly Choice Scarf Sneasler; Archaludon and Farigiraf were benched. Altaria is Timid Yache Berry Cloud Nine with Tailwind, Moonblast, Helping Hand, and Protect; it is a key support piece and is vulnerable to Taunt. Sneasler is Choice-locked after use and has Close Combat, Poison Jab, Coaching, and Upper Hand. Farigiraf has Armor Tail, Mental Herb, Imprison, Trick Room, Helping Hand, and Psychic Noise: do not rely on Talonflame priority into it, and expect its first Taunt to be cured by Mental Herb. Future plan: Mega Alakazam + Talonflame effectively pressures the Altaria-centered mode; directly pressure Farigiraf if it appears.

reflections.summary: Lost primarily because the chosen four lacked a reliable answer to Mega Alakazam plus Talonflame's immediate speed and Flying pressure. Team-preview plan was unfavorable: Mamoswine was vulnerable to Talonflame, Armarouge was exposed to Mega Alakazam's Shadow Ball, and Sneasler could not survive Brave Bird; no Mega Stone holder was brought or evolved. Piloting had no recorded decision errors, but the team could not recover after its first two attackers were removed.
reflections.adjustment: For the next game, avoid leading Altaria and Mamoswine together into Mega Alakazam/Talonflame; bring a four with stronger immediate anti-Talonflame and Mega Alakazam pressure, and preserve Sneasler or another fast attacker rather than exposing it to Brave Bird before it can act.
reflections.notebook: Opponent favors Mega Alakazam plus Talonflame for immediate Protect, Taunt, and fast Flying pressure. Mega Alakazam can Trace Cloud Nine, so weather-based plans may be unreliable. Talonflame has Gale Wings, Focus Sash, Tailwind, Taunt, and Brave Bird; respect its priority pressure and avoid assuming it is safely weakened. Future plan: prioritize anti-Talonflame and anti-Mega-Alakazam coverage, use early Protect or positioning to deny their combined pressure, and preserve a fast finisher.
